sections.title: Habit and habitat
sections.text: Desfontainia spinosa is an evergreen Andean shrub. It grows about 1.5–2.5 m tall and wide. Its leathery, glossy, spiny leaves resemble holly leaves; it grows in cool, moist mountain habitats.

sections.title: Flowers and fruit
sections.text: The red tubular flowers with yellow lobes can reach about 4 cm, followed by a berry. The plate accurately shows the prickly leaves, flower and cut fruit. No safe food use has been established; do not consume it.
